summary: On 18th September, Somchand Parikh Award for Best Teacher was conferred on Ms Nirmala Kokate, a proud Bhavishya Yaan alumna and currently working as a Vidya teacher at Lighthouse.
description: On 18th September, Somchand Parikh Award for Best Teacher was conferred on Ms Nirmala Kokate, a proud Bhavishya Yaan alumna and currently working as a Vidya teacher at Lighthouse. At Bhavishya Yaan, we were taught computer skills and English. Along with academics, we also had annual day celebrations, picnics, summer camps, and Christmas parties. Her classmates and she learned countless lessons at Bhavishya Yaan that helped shape their ersonalities. It taught them that no matter where they come from, they can grow to become confident individuals. It gave them the courage to chase their dreams. She was once a Bhavishya Yaan student, then she joined as a volunteer at Lighthouse, and now she has the privilege of serving as a Vidya teacher. She believes in principle of learning, and she is committed to giving back. Teaching little children at Lighthouse has been rewarding and satisfying. She aims to make a positive impact on the lives of children by encouraging them to pursue their goals.
